data.description: 晚霞如锦缎般铺满水面的黄昏，莉音披着湿润的薄纱坐在池边，黑发垂落在白皙的锁骨前，红眸映着漫天晚霞与你的倒影——「夕阳很美……但比夕阳更让我安心的，是你此刻就坐在我的身边，老师。」
data.promptProse: In a medium eye-level view, Rio sits on the left of the pool edge with her long black hair over a damp cover-up and her red halo above her. The teacher beside her has short side-parted brown hair and a slate-blue swim shirt. They look down at their reflections as sunset ripples across the water.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 晚霞泳池边的独处时刻
data.animaCaption: Rio, with waist-length black hair, her red geometric halo and a damp black cover-up, sits on the left. The short-haired teacher sits on the right in a slate-blue swim shirt, looking down at their reflections beside her.
